blocks.text: What Are Biological Treatments and Why Are They Important?

**Biological regeneration methods** play a critical role in treating hair loss and increasing the success of transplant operations. Utilizing the body's own healing mechanisms, **PRP (Platelet Rich Plasma)** and **Stem Cell (SVF)** therapies awaken dormant hair follicles, enhance cellular-level nutrition, and thicken existing hair strands.
✨ Cellular Power: PRP and stem cell therapies provide concentrated growth factors and regenerative cells directly to hair follicles, helping to halt the miniaturization process.
1. How is PRP (Platelet Rich Plasma) Therapy Applied?

In the PRP procedure, a small amount of blood is drawn from the patient and processed through a specialized centrifuge. As a result, the plasma portion rich in platelets and **growth factors** is separated and injected into the scalp using mesotherapy techniques.

items: **Immediate Cellular Triggering:** The injected platelets rapidly stimulate capillary circulation (angiogenesis) around the hair follicles.
**Session Planning:** Typically administered in courses of 3 to 4 sessions spaced 2-4 weeks apart, with annual maintenance sessions recommended.
**Role After Hair Transplantation:** Ensures that transplanted grafts adhere to the root faster and scabs shed much more quickly.

blocks.text: The action mechanisms and application frequencies of PRP and Stem Cell (SVF) treatments used to support hair health differ from each other:

rows: Multiple sessions per year in courses

blocks.text: 2. Stem Cell (SVF - Stromal Vascular Fraction) Therapy

Stem cell therapy is a non-surgical procedure that offers much stronger and deeper cellular repair compared to PRP. A very small amount of fat (adipose) tissue is typically harvested under local anesthesia from behind the ear or the abdominal region.

items: **High Repair Capacity:** Harvested adipose tissue undergoes specialized laboratory processing to be converted into a rich **Mesenchymal Stem Cell** suspension (SVF).
**Single Session Advantage:** Stem cells possess an advanced capacity to repair damaged hair follicles and form new vascular networks; usually a **single session** is sufficient.
**Early-Stage Solution:** An excellent alternative for patients who are not yet candidates for hair transplantation, experience localized thinning, and wish to enhance hair quality.

blocks.title: Frequently Asked Questions About PRP and Stem Cell Therapy

items.q: **Do PRP and stem cells completely stop hair loss?**
items.a: They do not completely eliminate the genetic hair loss process; however, by improving the quality of hair follicles, they significantly slow down loss and thicken weak strands.

items.q: **Is pain or discomfort felt during the procedure?**
items.a: Prior to the procedure, local anesthetic creams or mild regional numbing are applied to the scalp. Therefore, no pain is felt, and patients can return to daily life immediately after.

items.q: **Can it be performed alongside a hair transplant?**
items.a: Absolutely yes. PRP/stem cell support applied during or after hair transplantation maximizes the graft survival rate (take rate) and speeds up recovery.
